QuestInfo.name: In Search of the Eighth Storybook 1
QuestInfo.0: What is this 'eighth storybook' that Wiz mentioned?
QuestInfo.1: Collect #b50 Pounders#k and take them to Wiz the Librarian to find evidence of the eighth storybook.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Wiz the Librarian 50 Pounders.

0.0: Wait, my librarian senses are tingling. Yes, the book MUST be somewhere in the Korean Folk Town! The Dimensionial Crack must have mixed it in with all the other storybooks there.\r\n#L0##bExplain.#l\n#k
0.1: Don't you see? If the eighth storybook contains all stories, then all stories contain the eighth storybook!\r\n#L0##bI shall put my faith in your librariomancy for now. How can I find the storybook?#l\n#k
0.2: The animals around the story distortion are probably the most affected. If you hunt them, you might find some clue about the eighth storybook. Bring me, say, #b50 Pounders#k from the Moon Bunnies and we'll see what we can find.

yes.0: Think of all the good we could do if we found the eighth storybook!

no.0: Would you have me leave my secret hideout? No, I must stay here and remain vigilant!

1.0: Excellent, excellent. I'll take these Pounders to my secret laboratory right away.

item.0: You'll find the Moon Bunnies near the Entrance to Black Mountain. Don't worry, they're vile villains worthy of a good pounding!
